reviews.text:
In addition to regular pool service, we just completed a large spa and grotto addition to our existing pool by Blue Escapes. It turned out beautifully and the quality of work is excellent. We have a hard time finding contractors that we can trust to do things right, but Blue Escapes really knows what they're doing. Kevin, our project manager, was constantly checking in with us and keeping us apprised of progress, as well as quickly resolving city and HOA documentation requests.

Kevin came onsite regularly to check the work being done, and he made sure to be there for the entire gunite shoot and the plastering job. Their main crew also caught an issue with an unexpected void with the gunite shoot and had the gunite team come and redo that part to ensure it would be solid.

We got weekly update emails from their office and regular check-ins from Kevin. We had a ton of questions throughout the project and always got clear and understandable explanations. We ran into a few unexpected issue with the project (such as additional electrical code requirements from the city), and in those cases they were able to explain why those changes were needed or recommended so we could make informed decisions about change orders.

The only downsides to our project were outside of their control - our HOA took some time to get approvals finalized and that delayed our project more than we initially wanted, and we also ended up with some landscaping work that will have to wait till next year so that we can replant sod when it's warmer. They had to pull some pavers to run new plumbing, but they arranged to have those reset by paver specialists as part of the follow-up. If we had to do another large pool project we would probably aim to get everything started in fall so that it's more likely to be done in time for the summer months.

We were very happy with the end result of our project and would definitely work with Blue Escapes again.
reviews.author: Gordon Luk

reviews.text: Blue Escapes did an amazing job working on my pool. They brought in expertise on aesthetics, care, and structure that really brought my pool to life. Every question answered, every task completed timely. Could not recommend them enough for major pool work
reviews.author: Vinny

reviews.text:
Today I had the unpleasant and unfortunate experience with one of this companies employees not only did he call me the N-word. He also said that he was gonna shoot me in my face as well as punch me in my face. Not only am I disgusted that this is a man who is the age of a senior citizen if not almost to the age of a senior citizen you would think that he would be behave with decorum and would have self-respect for himself. Unfortunately, that was not displayed today his nefarious and nugatory statements created so much fear for my children and I  would think twice before spending your hard earned money with a company that does not uphold integrity while dealing with the public. It’s very disheartening especially with seeing high reviews of the craftsmanship coming from this company. It’s just very disappointing to see such disturbing behavior. I really do hope it’s addressed sooner rather than later

I’ve added pictures of the employee that displayed such disgusting behavior. He was trying to evade and avoid getting in contact with the police. I was on the phone with officers and letting them know his license plate as well as his description and car description as well. Hopefully they’re able to address this employee and proactively find a solution to avoid any of this happening in the future.
reviews.author: Samantha Onyekwere

reviews.text: Great experience with Blue Escapes fixing a leaking sprinkler line under the deck and a leak in the spa. Juan and Nestor did a fantastic job and were a pleasure to work with. Appreciate Kevin and Shannon's efficient management of the project. Would not hesitate to recommend Blue Escapes.
reviews.author: Marcus Burr

reviews.text: These guys knew exactly what they were doing!  Very professional and experienced. Zeroed in on a difficult pool leak with precision that others were not able to locate. They were NOT interested in selling work that was not necessary, which is very refreshing. Cleaned up well and restored the deck pavers in a manner that made their work undetectable. Very nice!!  Well done! Fair pricing.
reviews.author: Stuart Bergsma

reviews.text:
We had Blue Escapes bury our pool, add a new sprinkler zone, and place new sod.

Highly recommended!

They are honest and trustworthy, which goes a long way. They kept me informed throughout the entire process and promptly fixed an issue we discovered after the work was completed.

Bob, the owner, was very patient with us as we decided what to do with our dilapidated pool. He provided bids for several different options, which took time but really helped us make the right final decision.
reviews.author: DC

reviews.text: These guys (1) answer their phone, (2) know what they're doing, and (3) are very friendly and professional. I had them come out to help me fix multiple issues with my pool that another company could not figure out, and they were able to get it all sorted out quickly and were very reasonably priced. I highly recommend this company and will be using them for all future pool needs. Also, thank you to Kevin the GM - he was fantastic and took the time to explain everything.

reviews.text: The Blue Escapes team did an amazing job renovating our pool. They were very experienced and professional. I especially liked the weekly status updates, I wish more contractors were this easy to communicate with. I highly recommend this team!!

The duplicate review text is a minor anomaly but does not outweigh the volume and authenticity of other reviews.
